sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:30 – 14:30)
items: Equipment received: 4 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 1 x Ops Phone.
Morning shift deployed, debrief with night shift, no issues to report.
Gearing up to head on patrols.
Commencing patrols, heading down Queen Street.
Patrols along Lower Queen Street, Vulcan Lane, Shortland Street, Fort Street, Gore Street. No issues as most stores not yet open. Heading to Commercial Bay.
Welfare check McDonald's Britomart, all clear. Heading up Albert Street towards Victoria.
Welfare check on 77 Convenience store on Victoria Street, all clear.
Albert Street, Victoria Street clear; 77 Convenience welfare check clear.
Response call from Glassons reporting a male vagrant sleeping in front of their store. Colleague approached and asked him to move on; he complied and left without further issue.
Resuming patrols, heading to Aotea Square.
Aotea Square sweep complete. Heading to Lorne Street via Auckland Library.
Lorne Street sweep complete. Heading back to HQ to debrief with B Team.
B Team deployed. Standing by for response calls whilst debriefing.
Debrief Team 2, heading to High Street towards Freyberg.
Full sweep Freyberg Square, no issues.
Full sweep Chancery Square complete. Heading to Fort Street.
Full sweep rest of High Street complete.
Gore Street completed. Heading to Commercial Bay via Tyler Street.
Tyler Street completed. Commencing sweep Commercial Bay.
Commercial Bay, Commerce Street sweep complete. Standing by Lower Queen Street for response calls, maintaining presence until route changeover.
Response call from Chancery carpark requesting assistance to remove an aggressive vagrant from their property.
Arrived at carpark, commencing sweep of the building for the POI.
Aggressive vagrant removed with no escalation. Standing by at Chancery carpark in case he returns.
Standing down from Chancery carpark, heading back to Queen Street to maintain presence.
Heading back to HQ for route changeover, no issues on Lower Queen Street.
Standing by HQ debriefing with B Team, commencing route changeover.
Route changeover with B Team complete. Commencing welfare checks on Upper Queen Street.
Welfare checks complete. Heading up to Lorne Street.
Lorne Street sweep complete. Heading to Aotea via Auckland Library.
Quick walkthrough Auckland Library, no issues. Continuing patrol to Aotea.
Arriving at Commercial Bay, commencing sweep.
Full sweep Aotea Square complete. Heading to Victoria Street via Elliot Street.
Elliott Street / Darby welfare check clear. Heading up to Victoria Street.
Arriving at Victoria Street, commencing welfare checks.
Welfare check on Upper Queen Street complete. Standing by Queen Street maintaining presence.
Heading back to HQ for 30 minute break.
Morning shift complete. Handover and debrief complete, no further issues.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:30)
items: Equipment received: 4 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 1 x Ops Phone.
Received by word of mouth to keep a close eye on the Right Track TAB for a male vagrant removed from Barfoot & Thompson by Team 2 for obstructing property. Standing by showing presence.
Arrived Commercial Bay downtown waterfront. Heading back to HQ as requested by management.
Received response call regarding a female individual with her child suspected of taking merchandise from Queen Street Farmers.
Arrived at response location; staff advised they had already left the premises.
Spotted the female and child matching the description, approached and checked her for merchandise; nothing found.
Walked back to Queen Street Farmers to retrieve footage, but due to privacy reasons it could not be provided. Standing by showing presence.
Received response call from Mirrou clothing store: a female vagrant stole products and left the premises.
Arrived at response location, given photo evidence of the female vagrant suspected of stealing. Searching for the stolen merchandise.
Retrieved the stolen merchandise from the vagrant on Durham Street East. Continuing patrols.
Encountered by Police to keep a close eye on a male vagrant in front of New World Queen Street throwing food at members of the public. Standing by.
Arrived back at HQ to charge ops phone (low battery). Completing Auror reports while charging.
Commencing patrols, starting Alpha route from HQ.
Arrived Commercial Bay, commencing full sweep. Welfare check McDonald's Britomart all clear.
Commercial Bay sweep complete. Standing by for presence and on the lookout for problematic issues or vagrants.
Heading back to HQ, noticed a male sleeping outside a building blocking the emergency exit. Woke him and informed him to move along; he complied.
Patrolling Upper Queen Street. Welfare check Avachi Chicken, 77 Convenience store, McDonald's, BBQ Chicken, all clear.
Standing by for presence and any public risk.
Leaving standby. Commencing patrols up towards Aotea Square.
Full sweep Aotea Square clear, crossing to Lorne Street.
Auckland Library sweep complete. Commencing full sweep along Lorne Street with welfare checks.
Arrived corner Lorne Street / Victoria Street East. Welfare check on Lorne Street stores complete.
Arrived Freyberg Square / Chancery Square. Welfare checks along High Street for stores still open, all clear.
Freyberg Square / Chancery Square sweep complete. Heading back to office (low battery).
Received response call Queen Street McDonald's regarding two male individuals: one inside asleep with alcohol, one male vagrant outside in front of McDonald's.
Arrived, confirmed with staff who to remove; noticed one was the same male blocking the emergency exit earlier. Both males asked to leave and left the premises.
Arrived Darby Street. Welfare check Celines, Mali Thai, Pizza Club, Dominos, all clear. Standing by.
Received response call from Queen Street McDonald's again regarding the same intoxicated male who had re-entered the premises.
Arrived, spotted the male kicked out earlier, woke him and asked him to leave; intoxicated male left the premises. Standing by showing presence.
McDonald's Queen Street all clear. Heading back to HQ for 30 minute break.
30 min break finished, standing by for night shift handover and vigilant to response calls.
Afternoon shift complete, handover to night.
POI wanted by Police identified; photos/video on file.
Equipment handover: 4 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 1 x Ops Phone.

sections.title: Day Shift — Team 2 (09:00 – 17:00)
items: Equipment: 1 x Camera, 1 x Radio, 2 x Vest. Standing by HQ debriefing with Team 1.
Debriefing with A Team complete. Commencing patrol up Queen Street with welfare checks (Cotton On, Foot Locker, McDonald's and additional stores).
Workers taking lights down; Aotea sweep complete. Headed to Victoria Street.
Vagrants consuming liquor in an alcohol ban zone. Standing by as Officers dispose of the alcohol (footage on file).
Victoria Street sweep complete. Headed to the Cathedral.
Cathedral and Federal Street sweep complete. Heading to Lorne Street.
Debrief with A Team complete, route change. Commencing welfare checks down Queen Street.
Welfare check on Vans: a couple causing a disturbance in the store; female stole a pair of socks and damaged a few products. Female — crop top, tan pants, tattooed chest, 5'6; Male — all black, 5'7.
Peter Alexander welfare complete; one issue — store was flooded but no products damaged.
Continued full sweep Lower Queen Street, Vulcan Lane, Shortland Street, Fort, Gore Street complete. Making way to Commercial Bay.
Arrived Commercial Bay, commencing full sweep.
Full sweep Commercial Bay clear. Making way to HQ for route changeover.
Standing by whilst debrief with A Team afternoon shift.
Commencing welfare sweep up Queen Street.
Welfare sweep up Queen Street clear. Heading to Aotea Square.
Aotea sweep complete. Heading to Elliot Street.
Victoria welfare sweep complete. Heading to Lorne Street via Queen Street.
Upper Queen Street sweeps complete. Standing by Queen Street maintaining presence.
Due to weather conditions patrols catered to sheltered areas unless an emergency.
Heading back to HQ for 30 min.
A Team standing down, no issues to handover.

Welfare check Queen Street McDonald's, all clear.
Welfare check Victoria Street, top High Street.
Full sweep around Freyberg area and Chancery Square, all clear.
Standby Freyberg Square for nearby calls and showing presence.
Patrol through O'Connell Street, bottom of High Street, Fort Street, White Lady, all clear.
Welfare check Gore Street, Auckland Harbour Suites, all clear.
Welfare check Britomart, Commercial Bay, all clear.
Welfare check carpark next to Chemist Warehouse, all clear.
Welfare check Aotea Square, Mayoral Drive, all clear.
Welfare check 77 Convenience store on Victoria Street, all clear.
Welfare check Albert Mart Convenience store, all clear.
Welfare check Customs Street, Custom Mart Convenience store, all clear.
Welfare check Fort Lane, Fort Street Jo & Joe, all clear.
Welfare check High Street, High Street Supermarket, all clear.
Welfare check Chancery Square, Freyberg area, Upper High Street, all clear.
Welfare check Lorne Street, Auckland Library, all clear.
Check Darby Street, Elliott Street, all clear.
Patrolling up Victoria Street, all clear.
Welfare check 77 Convenience store, all clear.
Patrolling Federal Street towards Wyndham Street, all clear.
Patrolling down Wyndham Street towards Queen Street, all clear.
Welfare check Q Convenience store and Customs Mart, all clear.
Patrolling Fort Lane, Fort Street and the bottom of High Street, all clear.
Welfare check High Street Supermarket, all clear.
Full sweep around Chancery Square and Freyberg Square, all clear.
Welfare check bottom of Hobson Street, all clear.
Welfare check 77 Convenience store, top of Victoria Street, all clear.
Patrol down Victoria Street towards Queen Street, Lorne Street, all clear.
